assumptions.claim: For every existing ticketId where ownerOf(ticketId) succeeds, _ticketRanges[ticketId] has 1 <= firstEntry <= lastEntry <= totalEntries and (lastEntry - firstEntry + 1) equals the entryCount paid at mint time.
remainingRefundLiability >= aggregateEntries * ENTRY_PRICE for any batch of distinct unburned tickets in Status.Refunding.
assumptions.establishedBy: Raffle.buyEntries (packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L223, L232-L233), Raffle.enableRefunds (packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L296-L299), and single-burn enforcement in Raffle.refundTickets (packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L359, L364)

assumptions.claim: Once status is Status.Refunding, no state transition can move the raffle into Status.NftWon or Status.CashWon or allocate winner/sponsor/protocol proceeds from the same pot.

quoteToken is canonical 6-decimal USDC that holds at least remainingRefundLiability for address(this) and executes transfer(msg.sender, amount) without fees, rebasing, or reentrant callbacks into Raffle.
assumptions.establishedBy: RaffleFactory.constructor (packages/contracts/src/RaffleFactory.sol:L65-L85) for code presence and 6-decimal metadata; fee-free canonical USDC behavior is an external trust assumption (nothing found onchain for token identity beyond decimals and code length)

calls.propagates: Reverts with ReentrancyGuardReentrantCall if REENTRANCY_GUARD_STORAGE slot is ENTERED (2), sets slot to ENTERED (2) before body execution, and resets slot to NOT_ENTERED (1) after body execution (packages/contracts/node_modules/@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/ReentrancyGuard.sol:L69-L73, L88-L118).
Reverts with InvalidStatus(status) unless status == Status.Refunding (packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L573-L575).

Reads _owners[ticketId] via _requireOwned and reverts with ERC721NonexistentToken(ticketId) if the owner is address(0), establishing that ticketId was minted and has not yet been burned (packages/contracts/node_modules/@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC721/ERC721.sol:L61-L63, L146-L148, L426-L431).

Returns stored (_ticketRanges[ticketId].firstEntry, _ticketRanges[ticketId].lastEntry) without checking existence (packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L451-L455); caller relies on prior ownerOf(ticketId) check at L359 and buyEntries initialization at L226-L232.

Bypasses _isProtocolDestination because to == address(0) (packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L498), clears _tokenApprovals[ticketId], decrements _balances[owner] by 1, sets _owners[ticketId] = address(0), and emits Transfer(owner, address(0), ticketId) (packages/contracts/node_modules/@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC721/ERC721.sol:L216-L245, L303-L308).

Reverts with InvalidQuoteDestination(to) if _isProtocolDestination(to, address(prizeToken)) is true, then transfers amount of quoteToken to to via SafeERC20.safeTransfer (packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L564-L567).

Returns true if destination is address(this), factory, quoteToken, i_vrfV2PlusWrapper, prizeToken_, factory.raffleImplementation(), or (when destination.code.length != 0) a registered clone via factory.isRaffle(destination) (packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L593-L605).

Executes low-level call to quoteToken.transfer(msg.sender, amount) and reverts unless call succeeds and either returns true (1) or returns empty data with extcodesize(quoteToken) > 0 (packages/contracts/node_modules/@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/utils/SafeERC20.sol:L33-L37, L176-L200).

invariants.claim: refundTickets only executes in Status.Refunding and with 1 <= ticketIds.length <= 100 (MAX_REFUND_TICKET_BATCH_SIZE).
Every ticketId in ticketIds existed on entry, was distinct within the batch, was owned by msg.sender, and has _owners[ticketId] == address(0) after the loop.

All state mutations (_owners, _balances, _tokenApprovals, remainingRefundLiability) are committed before the external calls in _transferQuote(msg.sender, amount), and the function is guarded by nonReentrant.
remainingRefundLiability decreases by exactly sum(lastEntry - firstEntry + 1) * ENTRY_PRICE across the burned tickets, matching the quoteToken amount transferred to msg.sender.

calls.propagates: Reverts with ReentrancyGuardReentrantCall if REENTRANCY_GUARD_STORAGE slot is ENTERED (2), sets slot to ENTERED (2) before body execution, and resets slot to NOT_ENTERED (1) after body execution (packages/contracts/node_modules/@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/ReentrancyGuard.sol:L69-L73, L88-L118).
Reverts with InvalidStatus(status) unless status == Status.Refunding (packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L573-L575).

Reads _owners[ticketId] via _requireOwned and reverts with ERC721NonexistentToken(ticketId) if the owner is address(0), establishing that ticketId was minted and has not yet been burned (packages/contracts/node_modules/@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC721/ERC721.sol:L61-L63, L146-L148, L426-L431).

Returns stored (_ticketRanges[ticketId].firstEntry, _ticketRanges[ticketId].lastEntry) without checking existence (packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L451-L455); caller relies on prior ownerOf(ticketId) check at L359 and buyEntries initialization at L226-L232.

Bypasses _isProtocolDestination because to == address(0) (packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L498), clears _tokenApprovals[ticketId], decrements _balances[owner] by 1, sets _owners[ticketId] = address(0), and emits Transfer(owner, address(0), ticketId) (packages/contracts/node_modules/@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC721/ERC721.sol:L216-L245, L303-L308).

Reverts with InvalidQuoteDestination(to) if _isProtocolDestination(to, address(prizeToken)) is true, then transfers amount of quoteToken to to via SafeERC20.safeTransfer (packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L564-L567).

Returns true if destination is address(this), factory, quoteToken, i_vrfV2PlusWrapper, prizeToken_, factory.raffleImplementation(), or (when destination.code.length != 0) a registered clone via factory.isRaffle(destination) (packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L593-L605).

Executes low-level call to quoteToken.transfer(msg.sender, amount) and reverts unless call succeeds and either returns true (1) or returns empty data with extcodesize(quoteToken) > 0 (packages/contracts/node_modules/@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/utils/SafeERC20.sol:L33-L37, L176-L200).

invariants.claim: refundTickets only executes in Status.Refunding and with 1 <= ticketIds.length <= 100 (MAX_REFUND_TICKET_BATCH_SIZE).
Every ticketId in ticketIds existed on entry, was distinct within the batch, was owned by msg.sender, and has _owners[ticketId] == address(0) after the loop.

All state mutations (_owners, _balances, _tokenApprovals, remainingRefundLiability) are committed before the external calls in _transferQuote(msg.sender, amount), and the function is guarded by nonReentrant.
remainingRefundLiability decreases by exactly sum(lastEntry - firstEntry + 1) * ENTRY_PRICE across the burned tickets, matching the quoteToken amount transferred to msg.sender.
